subject: Vulnerability closure rhythm, scan schedule, and third-party dependency evidence
messages:
From: Lydia Chen <lydia@brightlinesec.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: scan cadence, SLA windows, and remediation proof for SOC 2/SIG

Hi Avery,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIG/SOC 2 follow-up for FinServe we need a compact evidence packet that covers vulnerability management practices. Specifically FinServe's audit team asked for the following items: 

- Scan cadence summary (authenticated network scans, external attack surface scans, container/image scanning cadence) and the retention/export of scan reports.
- SLA / target remediation windows for Critical / High / Medium findings and the exception/compensating-controls process.
- A sample remediation timeline for a resolved CVE (manifest showing discovery -> fix -> verification) covering at least one recent critical and one high CVE.
- A short attestation (signed) from a security or engineering lead confirming the timeline commitments and evidence indexes.
- Any third-party dependency scanning coverage and where those results live (SCA/OSS results).

If you can provide a single zip or a Drive folder with an index file plus the two sample remediation timelines and the attestation, that would be ideal. We would like to get this by end of week if possible — FinServe's compliance window is tight.

Two quick questions: are there any standard exceptions you issue for legacy services, and do you maintain an inventory of external vendor/component vulnerabilities separate from internal scans?

Thanks — we can schedule a 20–30 minute walk-through if helpful.

Best,
Lydia Chen
Principal Assessor
Brightline Security

--
Brightline Security | lydia@brightlinesec.com
From: Avery Johnson <avery@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia@brightlinesec.com>, Tom Aguilar <tom.aguilar@finserve.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: scan cadence, SLA windows, and remediation proof for SOC 2/SIG

Hi Lydia / Tom — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble a compact packet that meets the audit ask. Summary below plus what we will attach/upload to the Drive link.

Quick summary (top-level):
- Scan cadence: authenticated internal network scans weekly; external attack-surface scans weekly; full image/container SCA on merge to main (daily for active repos via CI); monthly end-to-end penetration scan and quarterly full environment scan for production fleets. All scan exports are retained for 12 months in our secure evidence store.

- SLA / remediation windows (target):
  * Critical (RCE/active exploit/privilege escalation): remediation to staging or mitigative rollback within 72 hours; mitigation/production deploy target 30 days unless emergency hotfix pushes earlier.
  * High (exploitability with significant impact): target remediation and verification within 14 calendar days.
  * Medium: target remediation within 90 calendar days.
  * Exceptions: documented on a per-CVE basis with compensating controls (network isolation, WAF rules, monitoring), reviewed weekly by the vulnerability ops team and approved by security.

- Evidence we will provide (in Drive and attached to this thread):
  1) vm_index.csv — index of included artifacts and mapping to SIG/SOC2 controls.
  2) cve_closure_timeline_snapshot.pdf — two redacted timelines (one Critical, one High) showing discovery timestamp, triage notes, remediation commit, verification logs and patch rollout.
  3) 3P_dependency_inventory.csv — inventory of third-party scanned components and SCA results location (Snyk/OSS scanner exports).
  4) attestation_signed.pdf — a short attestation from our Security Lead (Kimberly) confirming the cadence and SLA commitments (we will get this signed and upload by EOD Friday).

Next steps: I can upload the initial artifacts to the shared Drive now (link included in metadata). Can we schedule a 30-minute walkthrough Friday 10:00–10:30am PT or Monday morning? We can redact customer-identifying data from timelines as needed.

I also want to call out one operational detail: for legacy services that have strict constraints on deploy windows, we document exceptions and compensating controls in our exception register; those are surfaced in the evidence index and include review dates and mitigation evidence.

Attaching vm_index.csv and cve_closure_timeline_snapshot.pdf to this reply for immediate review. I will follow up once Kimberly has signed the attestation.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
avery@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: vm_index.csv (text/csv), cve_closure_timeline_snapshot.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Lydia Chen <lydia@brightlinesec.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: scan cadence, SLA windows, and remediation proof for SOC 2/SIG

Thanks Avery — pulling this together now. Quick notes:

- I will review the two timeline snapshots and sign the attestation. I expect to upload attestation_signed.pdf by EOD Friday (will use our standard short-form wording, but I will make one small edit to the critical-window language to read: "targeted response within 72 hours to mitigate exposure and 30 days for full production validation unless emergency hotfixed earlier"). Please confirm that wording is acceptable to the FinServe auditors (Lydia).

- I will also add the third-party dependency inventory (3P_dependency_inventory.csv) to the Drive folder; that file will include SCA result pointers and the last-scan timestamps.

- If Lydia wants a short 15–20 minute walkthrough of the artifact index, I can join Friday at 10am PT when Avery is available.
